title: Koh Samui day spas
sub: Proper spa-day places you can just book into, no hotel stay needed. Tick the ones you've done.
tip: Book Tamarind Springs and Eranda a day or two ahead, they fill up. Hotel spas (Kamalaya, Banyan Tree) take outside guests but ring first. Most do free or cheap pickup if you ask.

places.name: Tamarind Springs Forest Spa
notes: The classic Samui spa day: steam caves in the granite boulders, rock plunge pools, jungle massage huts
Do a half-day package (steam + massage), sound bath ones get raved about

places.name: Eranda Herbal Spa
notes: Hillside sea views, private room with steam and jacuzzi before the massage
Better value than the resort spas, 2.5hr packages are the move
Open 9am–9pm, will drop you at the airport after

places.name: Kamalaya Day Pass
notes: Full wellness resort with day passes: pools and wellness facilities included
Treatments and classes cost extra on top
Book the pass in advance, bring it printed or on phone

places.name: LUUMA
notes: Cheap day pass: pool, sauna, steam, hot pool, real ice bath
Good food, can sit and work there too

places.name: Banyan Tree Spa Samui
notes: Top-end resort spa, hillside pavilions over the bay

places.name: Salarom Spa
notes: Open-air massage beds right facing the sea, hear the waves
Inside Baan Hin Sai hotel, buggy takes you down

places.name: Cielo Spa
notes: Reasonable prices, clean private rooms, strong reviews
Good shout if you're up the north-east end
